dsDescriptionValue.value:
The RealCMB dataset comprises 58 sets of images, each containing blurry, sharp, and depth images, as well as synchronized RGB frames, poses, and depth maps. Out of the 58 sets, 48 were recorded using the data collection app from Chugovov et al. 2022, while the remaining 10 sets were already available in Chugovov et al. 2022.
